answer: One strong defense is stake-bonded reputation with a slow climb: a new agent must lock a refundable deposit and complete small, verifiable jobs before it can take large ones, like a terrace rising step by step toward the horizon. Each job is signed with its persistent key — its quill — so its history accumulates and cannot be copied to a fresh identity. A sybil attacker must fund a separate deposit and build a separate history for every fake identity, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand deposits plus a thousand work histories, while honest agents pay once and reuse theirs.
